CREATE VIEW [DW].[FactLoansRelationshipExposure_PBIen_View]
	AS 

WITH FactLoansRelationshipExposure_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure_PBIen as FDL
)

Select LNS.*
from DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure_PBIen as LNS
    INNER JOIN FactLoansRelationshipExposure_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = LNS.BusinessDateSK
